# FourierGraphConvolution

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A graph convolution operation performed in the Fourier domain, using spectral filters to capture global patterns across nodes. Provides a principled way to integrate topology with spectral analysis, enabling robust multivariate forecasting in graph-structured networks.
